constraints: At most two future actual actors, one each gated and ungated
Use existing public Context/preflight/dispatch and actor_cli transport
Equivalent substantive task/context; only required-gate protocol differs
Final checker/runtime plan remains pending scale/reuse candidate freeze
Stop if existing public transport cannot support the task without bypassing admission
excluded_effects: Any model invocation or implementation task
Any proof gate, compiler or heavy proof execution
Common status or Lean/Graphify candidate source edits
Old evidence or private origin material edits/inspection
Owner acceptance, Product feature adoption or public release
operation: Prepare the matched actual F_P software trial; freeze task, genuine sources, exact model view, protocol, hidden evaluation cases and transport templates without executing Workers or gates.
permitted_effects: Read public source, retained genuine evidence, and local executable chain/help without credential inspection
Write preparation artifacts and exact source copies only in granted territory
Run bounded pure data selection and static validation of preparation artifacts
stop: Return frozen preparation for independent review; no execution authority inferred.
